mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances despite rising FEDFUNDS rates, or Rank IC >0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 280 signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes that reduce equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 280 in the next month
failure_condition: Positive 20d returns occur despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 280, or IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% decline in GDPC1 (quarterly demand) during a late-cycle demand expansion predicts weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns persist despite GDPC1 decline in late-cycle context, or IC >0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 99 signals supply-side weakness, reducing production capacity and dampening corporate earnings growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite INDPRO falling below 99, or IC <0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of UNRATE above 4.7% signals tighter labor markets, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns persist despite UNRATE exceeding 4.7%, or IC <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS by >0.5% and a decline in UNRATE by >0.3% in the next month signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases >0.5% AND UNRATE decreases >0.3% in next month
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite the FEDFUNDS-UNRATE combination, or IC >0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 by >2% and INDPRO by >1% in the next month indicate robust demand and supply growth, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases >2% AND INDPRO increases >1% in next month
failure_condition: Negative returns persist despite the GDPC1-INDPRO combo, or IC <0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in HOUST below 1500 in a post-shock recovery regime signals demand weakness, undermining market confidence and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite HOUST falling below 1500, or IC >0.03 over any 2-year window.
